title: Olink® Target 96 Part 2/3: Extension
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol files and unzip them if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files (JSON extensions) as needed.

steps.title: Upload .py protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App; refer to the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press the ‘Run’ button in the OT App to execute the Extension protocol.
